definitions.explanation: A list of common questions and answers about a product, service, or topic.

examples.japanese: FAQ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
FAQ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{載|の}っていた→載る：27882_noru⟧。
examples.english: The answer was in the FAQ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{質問|しつもん}する→質問する：05637_shitsumonsuru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧FAQ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please check the FAQ page before asking questions.

notes:
FAQ stands for Frequently Asked Questions. Pronounced エフエーキュー in Japanese. Found on websites, product manuals, and customer service pages.

JAPANESE EQUIVALENT:
The native equivalent is ⟦よくある{質問|しつもん}→よくある質問：17498_yokuarushitsumon⟧, which is more accessible to general audiences. FAQ tends to appear on tech-oriented or international-facing sites, while ⟦よくある{質問|しつもん}→よくある質問：17498_yokuarushitsumon⟧ is preferred on Japanese consumer sites.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- FAQ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧: FAQ page
- FAQ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧: to check the FAQ
- FAQ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the FAQ
- FAQ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追加|ついか}する→追加する：19646_tsuikasuru⟧: to add to the FAQ

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦よくある{質問|しつもん}→よくある質問：17498_yokuarushitsumon⟧: frequently asked questions (native equivalent)
- Q&A（キューアンドエー）: questions and answers
- ⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせ：06131_toiawase⟧: inquiries, contact
